chips: What can you see about me?
Is my money safe with you?
What happens if I say no?

answers.What can you see about me?: Only what you’ve allowed: this account’s transactions. Everything I learn appears in You, with its evidence — and your corrections outrank my observations.
answers.Is my money safe with you?: I never move money without an agreement you’ve made, every move leaves a receipt, and one tap steps my permissions back down. No penalty, ever.
answers.What happens if I say no?: Nothing. Declining is always free here — the quiz, the ideas, all of it stays optional. I’ll still keep your receipts in order.
answers.A person, please: Of course. A named person picks this up with your context already in front of them — no phone tree, no starting over. Usually under two minutes at this time of day.

chips: Why is groceries under last month?
Can I pause the payday rule?

answers.Why is groceries under last month?: You’ve made 14 grocery payments totalling £212.40 — last month it was £250.40 by this date. No trick to it: two fewer big shops.
answers.Where did my round-ups go?: £22.00 went to your Emergency fund this month — receipt attached to each move. It’s at £430 of £1,000.
answers.Can I pause the payday rule?: Done in one tap, whenever you like — no penalty, nothing lost. It’s your rule; I just run it.
answers.A person, please: Of course. A named person picks this up with your context already in front of them — no phone tree, no starting over. Usually under two minutes at this time of day.

chips: Am I on track for the house?
What happens when the fund is full?

answers.Am I on track for the house?: Yes — £6,400 of £24,000, £320 each payday, on course for 2031. The rate stays 5.1% while the plan holds.
answers.What happens when the fund is full?: The £40 rule stops itself at £5,000. My suggestion — point it at the house; that brings 2031 about three months closer. Your call, and I’ll ask again when it happens.
answers.Show me my receipts: Every automated move sits in your feed as an ordinary row — 14 to the house pot so far, each with its receipt attached.
answers.A person, please: Of course. A named person picks this up with your context already in front of them — no phone tree, no starting over. Usually under two minutes at this time of day.

answers.What did Maya sign off?: This morning’s rebalance — back to your 36% floor after the market drift. Her signature is on the receipt in your feed.
answers.Are we still on plan?: Yes. All four plans on track at £850 a month. Nothing needs you — the quarterly review with Priya covers the rest.
answers.Book time with Priya: Priya holds Thursday 2pm for you. Shall I confirm it? She’ll come with the quarter’s numbers already read.
answers.A person, please: Of course — Priya is your named contact and holds Thursday 2pm. For anything sooner, a Premier specialist picks up with your context in front of them.
